grammarName.en: Quantifiers (much, many, a little, a lot of)
grammarName.ru: Слова количества (much, many, a little, a lot of)

scenario: The office gets a new automatic coffee machine. Everyone is excited, but there are small problems. There isn't much coffee powder left. Den puts too much sugar in his cup. Alex spills a little milk on the floor. Valery says there aren't enough cups for everyone. Pol reads the manual and says you shouldn't use a lot of sugar because it is bad for your health — everyone is a little annoyed by his healthy advice. In the end Kate orders a lot of coffee and new cups online, and everyone is happy. Light and warm. Use much / many / a little / a lot of / enough a lot.
